snippet.title: Grim Tales: Color of Fright
snippet.description:
iPad: http://bigfi.sh/1Kobwgd
iPhone: http://bigfi.sh/1RQRECP

Play a FREE trial of this immersive, high-quality game! Then pay once & play forever offline! 

A shadow from the Gray family’s past has returned for revenge. Can you save your family from their worst nightmares?

• YOUR FAMILY IS UNDER ATTACK!
It was bad enough that your train was running late, but now a mysterious note warns that this Gray family dinner will be the last! Inside the Gray family castle, everything is in chaos and your family is nowhere to be found.

• TAKE A WALK DOWN MEMORY LANE
Reunite with previous Grim Tales characters including Luisa, Elizabeth, James McGray, and even your niece, Jackie!

• UNCOVER HAUNTING FAMILY SECRETS
The walls are graffitied with the scribbles of a madman as his laughter echoes through the halls. Solve intriguing hidden object scenes and challenging puzzles while armed with your magical paint set!

• FIND OUT IF THE PAST CAN BE REWRITTEN IN THE BONUS CHAPTER
Unmask the kidnapper and beat him at his own game! Then enjoy exclusive extras such as stunning wallpapers, concept art, and replayable mini-games!
